READING THE ATLAS

Evidence before inference.

What a connection means

Ownership records a named shareholder or investor in a source. A percentage appears only when explicitly disclosed. Affiliation records an explicitly stated group or related-company connection, without inventing a stake. Board connections record a named directorship; they do not establish common control.

Dates matter

Annual reports are snapshots. “All snapshots” combines observations for exploration, not a simultaneous ownership structure. An undated company webpage is labelled undated even when its access date is known. The analysis lab multiplies stakes only at the same exact reporting date.

How evidence is reviewed

Records in this release were curated against official company disclosures or PSX-hosted documents. Automated text extraction assists research; it does not approve relationships. Each link points to its evidence and available page or section. “Reviewed” means a source was checked for the stated fact, not independently audited or guaranteed accurate.

What is missing

This is selected coverage. Small shareholders, private holding layers, nominee arrangements, ultimate beneficial ownership, and some transactions may be unavailable. Missing links mean unknown, not zero. Aggregate shareholder categories are not converted into named ownership links.

Group colours and calculations

Colours organise research networks; they do not calculate control. Ownership path products assume proportional economic rights. They are shown separately, not summed across overlapping or circular structures. Portfolio overlap describes shared named direct shareholders within the available snapshot.

Responsible interpretation

A publicly disclosed connection does not imply misconduct, political influence, or coordination. Family relationships are not inferred from surnames. This project is educational research and does not provide investment recommendations.

Corrections and reuse

To reproduce or challenge a finding, download the dataset, identify its relationship ID, and check the linked source and reporting date. See the repository’s methodology and contribution guide for the review process. Original reports remain the property of their respective publishers.
